# Our Wavelength

> A personal site exploring ADHD honestly — for adults navigating their own diagnosis and parents raising children with ADHD. Written from lived experience, not clinical expertise.

Our Wavelength (ourwavelength.co.uk) is a personal website covering:
- Adult ADHD: late diagnosis, what it feels like, what changes after
- Parenting a child with ADHD, including the particular experience of having ADHD yourself as a parent
- Practical strategies and tips that have genuinely helped, for both adults and parents
- Curated resources: books, websites, podcasts, and tools
- An ongoing blog with personal reflections and updates

The tone is warm, honest, and non-clinical. This is not a medical resource. It does not provide diagnosis or treatment advice. It is one person's account of living with and parenting around ADHD.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.ourwavelength.co.uk/): Introduction and overview of the site
- [My Story](https://www.ourwavelength.co.uk/my-story.html): Personal ADHD journey — life before diagnosis, the diagnosis itself, and what changed
- [ADHD Parenting Files](https://www.ourwavelength.co.uk/raising-adhd-child.html): Experiences and lessons from raising a son with ADHD
- [Practical Tips](https://www.ourwavelength.co.uk/practical-tips.html): Hub page linking to practical strategies organised by audience
- [Practical Tips — As an Adult](https://www.ourwavelength.co.uk/practical-tips-adults.html): Day-to-day strategies for managing your own ADHD
- [Practical Tips — As a Parent](https://www.ourwavelength.co.uk/practical-tips-parents.html): What's helped at home and school raising an ADHD child
- [Practical Tips — At Work](https://www.ourwavelength.co.uk/practical-tips-work.html): Strategies for the ADHD brain in a workplace setting
- [Practical Tips — Through a Child's Eyes](https://www.ourwavelength.co.uk/practical-tips-child-perspective.html): A child's-eye perspective on ADHD, written for the adults around them
- [ADHD Unpacked](https://www.ourwavelength.co.uk/adhd-unpacked.html): Curated collection of articles, videos, and resources to understand ADHD
- [What is ADHD?](https://www.ourwavelength.co.uk/what-is-adhd.html): A personal take on what ADHD actually feels like, plus the science behind it
- [Public Figures with ADHD](https://www.ourwavelength.co.uk/public-figures.html): Verified list of public figures who have spoken about their ADHD
- [Resources](https://www.ourwavelength.co.uk/resources.html): Recommended books, websites, podcasts, and tools
- [Book Review: ADHD 2.0](https://www.ourwavelength.co.uk/review-adhd-2-0.html): Personal review of ADHD 2.0 by Edward Hallowell and John Ratey
- [Workflow](https://www.ourwavelength.co.uk/workflow.html): The tools and systems used to stay productive at work with ADHD
- [Blog](https://www.ourwavelength.co.uk/blog.html): Ongoing personal posts
